entities.name: Sylvain Van de Weyer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Sylvain Van de Weyer was a British–Belgian politician who served as the Belgian Minister at the Court of St. James's, effectively the ambassador to the United Kingdom, and briefly, as the prime minister of Belgium, all under King Leopold I.
